title: The Specimens
summary: The foot of the cloud mountain, the dry season 2769. Lindqvist comes back for the creatures with the Academy's money: cage the young while the nest sleeps and bring the carts down to the river.

sides.name: The Academy's Expedition
sides.about: Dr. Lindqvist with the Academy's hired guns, porters and cage carts, and Benedito's canoes at the river.

sides.name: The Creatures
sides.about: The nest on the cloud mountain: the Mother in her hollow, her hunters and her grown young.

objectives.text: Dawn in {clock:dawn}: the nest wakes with the sun.
THE TAKING: stand by each sleeping young one to net it; its cart comes for it ({caged} of {young0} caged).
The eggs: Lindqvist stands 8 seconds at the swamp's edge in the hollow, then carries them.
Walk softly: keep away from the sleeping nest.
THE TRAIL: guard the cage carts down to the river ({freed} broken). Porters mend a hurt cart.
THE LANDING: bring the carts onto the quay ({cages} loaded, room for {room}). Lindqvist goes last.
THE NEST SLEEPS: strangers are in the ferns. Your hunters sleep until they come close. Root the Mother and GROW her; MATURE your young ones.
FREE THE YOUNG: break the cage carts ({freed} of {cages0} freed: half will do), or kill the doctor, before the canoes leave.

k_open1.text: The doctor came before me in chains, an old man. He asked to tell it himself.

k_open2.text: I let him. He tells it as his finest hour. I will say where it was not.

l_open1.text: Majesty. Two years after the station burned, the Academy gave me money again.

l_open_saved.text: The eggs I carried out of the fire had hatched. I needed a father for them.

l_open_burned.text: I had nothing left but my notes. I needed eggs, and young ones.

l_open2.text: In the dry season we went up the mountain, with guns, porters and carts.

k_open_c.text: No creature told me this. But the nest was theirs, and the young were theirs.

k_open_c2.text: That dry season men came with cages while the nest slept.

l_1.text: Quietly. The young sleep apart from the nest, in the ferns.

l_2.text: Stand by each one a moment and net it. The carts will come for them.

tip_1.text: The eggs lie at the swamp's edge in the hollow. I will fetch those myself.

l_sire.text: And the young Sire in the middle. A father for my line.

l_fresh.text: Two young and a clutch of eggs. Enough to begin again.

l_short.text: We have the mapmaker's road. The carts go straight down the commission's path.

l_long.text: No map. Benedito remembers an old way down on the west side. A long road through the forest.

p_book.text: I have the specimen book, Doctor. I will count every cage.

l_pieter.text: I keep the book myself now. Pieter used to.

l_taken.text: So many young. The pack carried my clutch up here after all.

tip_porters.text: The porters can mend a cart. Keep them close to the cages.

l_net_w.text: The net is on it. Bring the cart.

l_net_m.text: Gently. He weighs more than three men already. The cart!

l_net_e.text: Mind its mouth, it spits even asleep. The cart.

l_eggs.text: The eggs. Warm. I carry them myself.

l_all.text: All of them. Now down, before the sun.

l_woke.text: They are awake! The carts, now! Down the mountain!

l_empty.text: Nothing. We go down with empty cages.

l_trail.text: The carts are rolling. Keep the guns round them.

tip_trail.text: The carts carry our powder too. A man who has fired his shots refills beside one.

l_raid1.text: In the trees! They want the cages!

l_grown.text: Those are not hatchlings. Last year's young, grown. Look at them.

l_freed.text: A cage is broken! It is loose!

l_lost.text: Every cage broken. Two years for nothing.

b_1.text: Here, Doctor! The canoes are ready. Load the cages.

l_crates.text: Whose crates are those on the quay?

b_crates.text: From Lisbon, for the mines in the south. Heavy. A gear stamped on the wood.

b_room_few.text: Few paddlers came from Nazaré, Doctor. Two cages, no more.

b_room_many.text: All of Nazaré came to paddle. There is room for every cage.

n_roar.text: Up the river bank something roared, and the forest went quiet.

l_sire_comes.text: The Sire. He has come for the last cart. Hold him off!

b_full.text: No more room, Doctor! The canoes are full!

l_end.text: We went down the river with the cages rattling.

b_gone.text: The canoes are going, Doctor! We cannot wait!

l_hurt.text: I am hurt. Keep them off me!

l_end_all.text: Every cage came down to the river. The finest expedition of my life.

l_end_some.text: Not every cage came down, but enough.

l_end_few.text: Only a few cages came down. It was enough for me.

l_end_saved.text: The young Sire was for the eggs I saved. In a year I had a breeding stock.

l_end_burned.text: The eggs I took that night were my new beginning.

l_end_eggs.text: I carried the eggs down myself, all the way to the river.

l_end_pieter.text: Pieter wrote every cage in the book.

k_end1.text: His finest hour, he calls it. He took a mother's young in the night.

k_end2.text: And the crates on that quay went south to the mines. Nobody opened them.

k_end_c1.text: That is not how it went. The carts came down to the river.

k_end_c2.text: But it could have gone that way. Then the doctor would have come home with empty cages.

new_stage2.text: NEW: GROW. Rooted, the Mother grows to her second stage: more eggs, and the young may MATURE.

new_tyrant_challenger.text: NEW: MATURE. A grown Raptor moults into a Tyrant Challenger; a grown Spitter into a Venom Challenger.

text: The cloud mountain, the dry season 2769. You are Dr. Lindqvist, with the Academy's hired guns, porters and cage carts.
By night, net the sleeping young and take the eggs. By day, bring the cages down to Benedito's canoes.
Lindqvist must live. Do not wake the nest.
The cloud mountain, the dry season 2769. You are the nest: the Mother in her hollow, her hunters asleep.
Men with cages are in the ferns. Grow the Mother and the young while you sleep; when they take to the trail, free the cages.

expedition.title: Down to the river
expedition.text: Lindqvist brought the cages down to Benedito's canoes.

creatures.title: The cages are broken
creatures.text: The young went back to the mountain. The doctor's carts came down empty.
